3516.title: Supervisor executable mode omitted
3516.rootCauseOneLine: The browser supervisor launches the current executable with a sanitized environment that omits Electron Node mode.

prReviews.topFinding: Conditional supervisor mode and child environment cleanup match the mechanism; PR code was not run.

3516.proposedFix: Select Node mode for the Electron supervisor while keeping external-child environments sanitized.
3516.caveats: Two clean code-boundary runs; Linux AppImage and live session timeout not exercised. Existing linked PR precludes a duplicate fix.
